review: Inspected original and prepared image. Weathered smiling olive face, shoulder-length wavy brown hair, slim tall traveler with ivory/forest/ochre costume. Lifted scarf, bronze abstract weather vane and reed wand distinguish from forge/fire silhouettes. Complete hands/boots/props, no letters on instrument. Teatro painterly coherence. Integration and actual miniature readability remain to be verified.
